note: Reviewed CDB90 match 3, pinned revision e0b35ec4d798cec3bb4e6970c0f6bb7aa69e2f4c. CDB90 (CAA Database of Battles, Version 1990), tidy data maintained by Jeffrey B. Arnold. Original US Army Concepts Analysis Agency data; revised data licensed ODC-BY. Original force designations and strength interpretations are retained with each quantity. Each side is one aggregate force, including any coalition; its total is not allocated among members. Personnel casualties are not deaths. Source estimates and adjudged error margins are not statistical confidence intervals. Equipment and tactical movements are not established by this dataset. Match review: Wimpfen 6 May 1622 remains approved with unchanged CDB quantities. PROT UNION ARMY / BADEN-DURLACH receives a sourced local identity: Georg Friedrich's army. NDB explicitly dates the Union's dissolution to May 1621 and describes the army Georg Friedrich subsequently raised and led at Wimpfen. HOLY LEAGUE & SP ARMY remains a combined local source force. Identity review (defender; original CDB90 name PROT UNION ARMY): CDB PROT UNION ARMY / BADEN-DURLACH is preserved in source provenance. NDB describes the Union's dissolution in 1621 and the army raised afterwards by Georg Friedrich, defeated at Wimpfen on 6 May 1622. The existing complete local force is renamed without assigning its total to a guessed polity or changing any quantity.
